declared_exclusions.item: The existing --fetch flag reads ok=False on the released state (NFRA_CTLPLN-W122-S5)
declared_exclusions.reason: --fetch's ok expression requires one wheel still held in holding and a disk hash equal to the fetch record; the released wheel no longer meets it. The issuer's ruling covered --check only, so --fetch is unchanged by this seat pending a ruling.
